hurdle_name: Market Access & MPEDA/EU Export Infrastructure Costs
evidence_quote: Respondents found securing the CE certificate and pollution control board certificate particularly difficult, and cited higher lead times for import permits, involvement of multiple agencies (EIC, Customs, FSSAI) in issuing clearance, and the cost of testing samples of imported raw materials — friction that reduces their ability to import inputs for further processing for export.
Implementation of Veg.Net portal to strengthen the monitoring and traceability for exports of Drumstick and Green Chilies to the European Union (EU)

To prevent trade disruptions at European ports, APEDA is upgrading its TraceNet digital infrastructure to capture farm-level geolocation polygons. Registered exporters must upload GPS coordinates verified by State Horticulture Departments or remote sensing satellite imagery for all registered contract farming plots.

hurdle_name: FSSAI Hygiene Standards & Facility Audit Compliance
evidence_quote: While domestic Indian processing requires FSSAI Schedule 4 hygiene compliance, FSVP places the legal and financial liability directly on the US importer to audit Indian processing units, review annual EIC/NABL analytical certificates, and conduct on-site third-party facility audits.
